source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the male reproductive system (PDF 73-77).

items: Gonads (testes): do bayzavi testes, taqreeban 3 se 5 cm lambe aur 2 se 3 cm chaure, pait ke bahar jild ki theli, scrotum, mein. Har aik bohat bal khayi seminiferous tubules se bana hai jin ki deewar, germinal epithelium, mein germline cells (jo meiosis se sperms banate) aur Sertoli cells (jo unhein ghiza dete) hain.

Madadgar nalyan (accessory ducts): seminiferous tubules se sperm rete testis, phir lambi bal khayi epididymis mein jate hain jahan kam az kam 18 ghante be-harkat reh kar harkat ke qabil hote; phir vas deferens, jo inguinal canal se pait mein ja kar seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar ejaculatory duct banati hai. Do ejaculatory ducts prostate se guzar kar urethra mein khulti hain jo bladder se aa kar penis se bahar khulti hai.

Madadgar glands, jo sperm mein mayi mila kar semen banate: do seminal vesicles (fructose bhara mayi jo sperm ko tawanai deta); bladder ke neeche prostate gland (naram aur spongy, semen ka taqreeban 60%); aur do bulbourethral glands (saaf mayi jo urethra ko chikna aur hifazati neutral mahol deta).
Jinsi uzv (penis): is mein urethra, erectile tissue, aik artery aur do veins hain.

blocks.title: Testes bahar kyun hain
blocks.text: Testes pait ke andar bante aur paidaish se zara pehle scrotum mein utar aate hain. Scrotum unhein taqreeban 34 C par rakhta hai, jism ke andaruni 37 C se thora kam, jo sperm ki nashonuma ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: mardana tolidi aaza ka saada saamne ka khaaka: peshab ka bladder, us ke neeche prostate gland, do seminal vesicles, do chhote bulbourethral glands, penis mein se neeche jati urethra, aur scrotum mein do testes, har aik ke saath epididymis aur vas deferens jo oopar mur kar urethra se milti hai. Daen: seminiferous tubule ki tarash, deewar par germline cells, Sertoli cells, beech ke lumen mein sperm ki dumein aur tubules ke darmiyan Leydig cells.
blocks.caption: Mardana tolidi nizam aur testis ki tarash (Figure 17.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har testis, scrotum mein taqreeban 34 C par, bal khayi seminiferous tubules se bana hai jin ke germline cells meiosis se sperm banate aur Sertoli cells unhein ghiza dete hain; tubules ke darmiyan Leydig cells testosterone banate hain. Sperm rete testis se epididymis mein jate hain jahan kam az kam 18 ghante baad harkat ke qabil hote, phir vas deferens mein, jo seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar ejaculatory duct banati hai; ejaculatory ducts prostate se guzar kar urethra mein khulti hain jo penis mein se guzarti hai. Seminal vesicles fructose bhara mayi, prostate semen ka taqreeban 60% aur bulbourethral glands saaf chiknai wala mayi shamil karte hain.

blocks.text: Spermatogenesis seminiferous tubules mein sperm ka banna hai. Tubule ki deewar ke germline cells (2n) mitosis se taqseem hote; kuch spermatogonia (2n) bante aur kuch germline cells hi rehte. Spermatogonia primary spermatocytes (2n) banate jo lumen ki taraf jate hain. Har primary spermatocyte meiosis I se do secondary spermatocytes (1n) mein batta jo foran meiosis II se spermatids (1n) banate: aik spermatogonium chaar spermatids deta, har aik lamba sperm ban jata hai.

Sperm ka sar, midpiece aur dum hoti hai. Sar mein jeeni madda hai aur us ka taqreeban do tihai acrosome se dhaka hai, jo zyada tar Golgi body se bani topi hai aur jis ke enzymes sperm ko ovum fertilize karne mein madad dete hain. Midpiece mein mitochondria aur centriole hain; dum us centriole se nikalne wale microtubules (axial filament) se bani hai. Lumen mein pakke sperm be-harkat hote aur Sertoli cells ke mayi ke saath epididymis tak pohanchte hain; wahan harkat ke qabil hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: spermatogenesis cells ki zanjeer ki shakal mein: germline cell (2n), spermatogonium (2n), primary spermatocyte (2n), meiosis I se do secondary spermatocytes (1n), meiosis II se chaar spermatids (1n) aur chaar sperms, neeche sperm ka sar, acrosome, midpiece aur dum. Daen: oogenesis: oogonium (2n), balooghat tak prophase I mein ruka primary oocyte (2n), meiosis I se secondary oocyte aur pehla polar body, aur sperm dakhil ho to meiosis II se aik ovum aur doosra polar body.
blocks.caption: Spermatogenesis aur sperm ki banawat (Figure 17.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Testis mein germline cells mitosis se taqseem hote; kuch spermatogonia bante jo primary spermatocytes banate; har primary spermatocyte meiosis I se do secondary spermatocytes aur meiosis II se chaar spermatids banata, jo sar (nucleus aur acrosome), midpiece (mitochondria aur centriole) aur dum wale sperms ban jate hain. Ovary mein oogonia paidaish se pehle primary oocytes banate jo prophase I mein ruk jate hain; balooghat se aik aik kar ke meiosis I poori kar ke bara secondary oocyte aur chhota pehla polar body banta hai; metaphase II mein ruka secondary oocyte ovulation par chhoota aur sirf sperm dakhil hone par meiosis II poori kar ke aik ovum aur doosra polar body banata hai.

blocks.text: Spermatogenesis hypothalamus aur pituitary ke hormones ke qaboo mein hai. Hypothalamus gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) chhorta hai jo anterior pituitary se FSH aur LH chhurwata hai. FSH seminiferous tubules se spermatogenesis karwata hai. LH tubules ke darmiyani tissue ke Leydig cells se testosterone chhurwata hai, jo germinal epithelium ko jagata aur mardana sanvi khasusiyat qaim rakhta hai. FSH Sertoli cells se inhibin bhi chhurwata hai, aik peptide hormone jo mazeed FSH rokta hai, aur testosterone LH aur GnRH ka ikhraj rokta hai.

blocks.alt: Flow chart. Hypothalamus GnRH chhorta hai jo anterior pituitary se FSH aur LH chhurwata hai. FSH seminiferous tubules ke Sertoli cells par asar kar ke spermatogenesis karwata; LH tubules ke darmiyan Leydig cells par asar karta jo germinal epithelium aur mardana khasusiyat ke liye testosterone chhorte hain. Dashed teer negative feedback dikhate hain: Sertoli cells ka inhibin FSH rokta aur testosterone LH aur GnRH rokta hai.
blocks.caption: Mardana tolidi nizam ka hormonal qaboo (Figure 17.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hypothalamus ka GnRH anterior pituitary se FSH aur LH chhurwata hai. FSH Sertoli cells ke zariye seminiferous tubules se spermatogenesis karwata; LH Leydig cells se testosterone chhurwata jo germinal epithelium ko sahara aur mardana sanvi khasusiyat qaim rakhta hai. FSH se jage Sertoli cells inhibin chhorte jo mazeed FSH rokta, aur testosterone LH aur GnRH ka ikhraj rokta hai: do negative feedback chakkar.

blocks.prompt: Seminiferous tubule se bahar tak sperm jin hisson se guzarta hai, tarteeb se batayein.
blocks.explanation: Seminiferous tubule, rete testis, epididymis, vas deferens, ejaculatory duct (prostate mein se), urethra (penis mein).

items: Testes (scrotum mein, 34 C): germline aur Sertoli cells wali seminiferous tubules; Leydig cells testosterone banate.
Nalyan: rete testis, epididymis, vas deferens, ejaculatory duct, urethra; glands: seminal vesicles, prostate, bulbourethral.
Aik spermatogonium se chaar sperms; GnRH, FSH (sperm), LH (testosterone), inhibin aur testosterone ka feedback.
